title: Characterization of molecular-pathological pain-inducing tissue components in patients with lipedema
summary: Lipedema is characterized by bilateral deposition of subcutaneous adipose tissue. In addition, patients are highly sensitive to pressure and suffer from pain in the affected extremities. The aim of this study is to investigate to which extend the pressure sensitivity and detection ability for vibration is altered in patients with lipedema in comparison to obese and healthy controls. In addition, tissue samples will be collected for further molecular-pathological analyses. Underständing the clinical appearance of lipedema pain might help to investigate the underlying pathomechanisms in further studies. This may lead to the development of new therapeutic strategies.

interventions.name: lipedema patients: assessment of the pressure pain threshold and vibration detection threshold, molecularpathological investigation of tissue samples.
obese controls: assessment of the pressure pain threshold and vibration detection threshold, molecularpathological investigation of tissue samples.
